items.title: 15 of the Highest-Yielding Dividend Stocks in the S&P 500
items.summary: VICI Properties, UPS and General Mills lead the list of the highest-yielding dividend stocks in the S&P 500. Some of the other names might surprise you.

items.title: 5 Blue-Chip Dividend Stocks Built to Keep Paying Through Tough Markets
items.summary: A fat yield means nothing if the cash isn't there to fund it. Five blue chips face the same coverage test, and two of them pay out with almost no room to spare. Which dividends hold up when markets turn?

items.title: How Much You Really Need Invested to Generate $50,000 a Year in Retirement
items.summary: Safe blue chips have rallied so hard that their yields now trail Treasuries, while the highest payers promise to slash the capital you need. Before you chase either, see what each shortcut quietly puts at risk in year ten.

items.title: $100,000 in These 5 Dividend Stocks Could Pay $4,800 a Year
items.summary: When the paycheck stops, price charts matter less than the cash landing in your account each quarter. Five high-yield names across pharma, utilities, tobacco, telecom, and midstream energy compete for that job, and one carries the thinnest safety cushion of all.

items.title: Can MO's Basic Brand Benefit From Growing Discount Cigarette Demand?
items.summary: Altria's Basic brand gains retail share as budget-conscious smokers shift to discount cigarettes amid growing consumer preference for lower-priced options.

items.title: 4 Dividend Stocks Yielding 5% to 10% That Pay You Tax-Free in a Roth IRA
items.summary: Four high-yield stocks can hand the IRS a surprisingly large slice of your income every year, and the bill grows with your bracket. One account type changes that math, and the gap compounds for decades.

items.title: Vanguard U.S. Momentum Factor ETF (VFMO) Adds Altria and ADP on Thursday
items.summary: The fund bought $13.6 million of Altria and $12.9 million of ADP while selling out of KLA and Corning.

items.title: Altria Yields 5.9%. Here's How Many Shares You'd Need for $5,000 in Yearly Dividend Income.
items.summary: The cigarette giant has reliably raised its payouts annually for decades.
